text: starter design two_arm_simple. header optional. minimum need design object (default named design). Parameter tips plain strings params:; quote keys "N" "b". soon file sits inst/designs/, available make_design(), get_args(), get_code(), maintainer audits, run_shiny().
code: --- id: two_arm_simple label: Simple two-arm trial category: template keywords: [experiment, two-arm] description: >   Simple two-arm trial with complete random assignment and a population average treatment effect. params:   "N": "Number of units (sample or population size)"   "b": "Treatment effect (outcome scale)" diagnosands: [bias, power] include_in_shiny: true ---  design <-      declare_parameters(     N = 1000,  # Number of units     b = 0.2    # ATE   ) +      # M: model   declare_model(N = N, Y_Z_0 = rnorm(n()), Y_Z_1  = Y_Z_0 + b) +      # I: Inquiry   declare_inquiry(ATE = mean(Y_Z_1 - Y_Z_0)) +    # D: Data strategy     declare_assignment(Z = complete_ra(n())) +    declare_measurement(Y = Z*Y_Z_1 + (1-Z)*Y_Z_0) +      # A: Answer strategy   declare_estimator(Y ~ Z, .method = difference_in_means, inquiry = "ATE")
